voiceoverScript: A little oil film does not automatically prove failure. Light misting can occur around some seals. Heavy wet streaks or drips are different. A dry unit can also be worn. Inspect condition and performance before deciding.
selectedCaption: A slight oil film or misting can occur around some shock or strut seals without proving failure; extensive wetness, runs, drips, damage, or poor damping are a different condition. Light shock or strut misting is different from an active hydraulic leak. Nick's Tire & Auto can inspect the actual condition before parts are replaced.
